basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading SHOULD, inferred under the quoted sentence. description: An inception and an interaction signed by the current key, then a rotation at sequence number 1, signed by the pre-rotated key, that supersedes the interaction (rule A0). A validator should accept the rotation and keep the interaction as seen but off the trunk. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0046 (KS-63) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: superseding recovery of one interaction
